bagPolicy.summary: Citi Field enforces a clear bag policy to ensure guest safety and expedite entry. Approved bags include clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutches no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small clutches no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”
prohibited: Bags larger than a small clutch
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are exceptions.

parking.note: Citi Field offers parking for regular season and special events with prices ranging from $40 to $120 depending on vehicle type and event. Fans are encouraged to use discounted offsite parking at Skyview Mall, a 10-minute walk from the stadium. All payments are cashless, with credit/debit cards and mobile payments accepted.

rideshare.note: Meet your rideshare in Stadium View East parking lot, beneath the highway north of Shea Road and Boat Basin Place.

concessions.note: Citi Field offers a variety of food and drink options including a lively Beer Garden with local and popular beers, and several concession stands serving comfort foods with bold flavors. Highlights include specialty items like Bacon Wrapped Hot Dogs, Pastrami Fry, and indulgent desserts like Soft Serve and Milkshakes.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The following sensory resources are available at no charge at the Lost and Found located in the Jackie Robinson Rotunda as well as Fan Assistance HQ at Section 106 for use during games and events: Empire Suites 201-239 are located on the Empire Suite Level, which is accessible from any of the three VIP entrances - Hodges, Seaver and Stengel - via elevator or staircase.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For ticket sales, questions and concerns, fans may call the Mets Ticket Office at (718) 507-TIXX to speak to a Ticket Office representative. The main box office ticket windows at Citi Field are located on the exterior of the ballpark, on the third base side of home plate and the Jackie Robinson Rotunda, adjacent to the Ticket Services Office.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Guests with accessibility needs may also enter through our designated accessible gates (Hodges, Seaver, or Stengel VIP entrances) even if their seating location does not grant them VIP entry.
